## HN discussion (0 comments)

(no comments)
{"decision": "pass", "reason": "页面说明了它把美国地址的地块线、等高线、土壤、洪灾区和湿地等公开数据整理成 CAD/GIS 可用的底图，并支持自定义图层命名。但证据里没有数据源处理、精度或实现细节，主要是把公开 GIS 数据产品化，看不出可复用的技术洞见或明确的差异化机制。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason's page details are all on the page: parcel lines, contours, soils, flood zones, wetlands, CAD/GIS output and custom layer naming. It is also right that the page gives no data-source, accuracy or implementation detail, and its view that this is a productization of public GIS data lacking a differentiating technical mechanism supports the pass.
